item.title: WATCH: 'He says what he thinks!' Thomas Skinner shares his thoughts on Donald Trump
item.description: Thomas Skinner praised Donald Trump for his blunt, no-nonsense style, saying the US President “says it exactly how it is”. The Apprentice star said voters are fed up with politicians who promise one thing and deliver another, calling Trump’s straight talking “refreshing”. item.title: EE launches refurbished phone range as customers call carrying second-hand gadgets a 'badge of honour'
item.description: EE has just unveiled a new way to upgrade your phone at a fraction of the price. This new range arrives in response to the growing "Tech Thrifters" movement, which is an increased desire to own second-hand tech gadgets. item.title: GB News Daily Reflection - Thursday 22nd January 2026
item.description: In today’s Daily Reflection we explore a wedding story from the Gospel of John, where the hosts run out of wine. Vicar Jordan recalls a friend’s wedding with surplus wine, and how he joyfully took home the extra bottles.At the wedding in John’s Gospel, Jesus miraculously turns six large jars of water into the best wine, showing God’s abundance.Jordan reflects that God’s love is overflowing and that when we ask, God gives good things generously.WATCH THE DAILY REFLECTION ABOVE
